patterns.name: Narrative survives better than geometry-enabling raw data
patterns.definition: Strong reports, official summaries, testimony, or authenticated media survive while synchronized raw sensor streams, calibration, platform state, and error models are missing or incomplete.
ordinary_explanations: data never recorded or not preserved
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Recover original synchronized raw tracks plus calibration and platform/navigation timebase.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: A property of the evidence pipeline, not evidence about the object's origin.

patterns.name: Multiple reported channels without reproducible common-time fusion
patterns.definition: Several cases report visual, radar, ELINT, IR, or system-effect channels, yet the public record does not supply synchronized calibrated data proving that every channel measured the same physical object.
nonordinary_hypotheses_not_excluded: one physical target genuinely observed through multiple channels
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Common-clock raw sensor records with geometry showing intersecting uncertainty volumes for the same target.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Multi-channel testimony raises evidential interest but is not equivalent to multi-sensor measurement.

patterns.name: Events are enriched in high-observation military/aviation environments
patterns.definition: Most frozen cases occur where trained observers, radar/IR/ELINT systems, intercept procedures, or formal reporting channels are unusually dense.
nonordinary_hypotheses_not_excluded: a real phenomenon preferentially approaching strategic activity
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Compare event rate per sensor-hour/observer-hour against matched non-strategic environments with the same sensor suite and reporting policy.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Raw case counts near military assets cannot establish attraction without a denominator.

patterns.name: Range/parallax/propagation/tracking ambiguity can manufacture apparent performance
patterns.definition: Cases or controls lose extraordinary-motion interpretations when range, atmospheric propagation, platform motion, zoom, or target distance are treated correctly.
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Independent range plus platform pose plus atmospheric profile and raw imagery/radar.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Apparent speed or acceleration without independent range is not robust kinematics.

patterns.name: Bright, smooth, or low-detail targets recur among strong residual narratives
patterns.definition: Several top residuals describe high-contrast/luminous or feature-poor targets rather than richly resolved structures.
nonordinary_hypotheses_not_excluded: a genuinely featureless or luminous physical platform
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Unsaturated multispectral imagery with known range and angular resolution sufficient to resolve structure.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Low structural detail is expected under many ordinary imaging conditions and is not a technology signature.

patterns.name: Target behavior is sometimes reported as contingent on interception or approach
patterns.definition: In several high-interest narratives the unknown appears to change position, range, or behavior during an aircraft approach/intercept.
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Synchronized target and interceptor state vectors showing statistically contingent maneuvers beyond geometric expectation.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Reported responsiveness is interesting but currently cannot be separated from pursuit geometry.

patterns.name: Electromagnetic/instrument disruption
patterns.definition: Loss or degradation of aircraft communications/instrumentation temporally associated with the reported object.
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Maintenance logs, bus voltage/current, RF spectrum, fault codes, independent aircraft experiencing correlated effects at known geometry.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Do not generalize the Tehran system-effects report to UAP as a class.

patterns.name: Round/orb reports dominate modern AARO morphology statistics
patterns.definition: AARO's published reporting trends show round/orb/sphere as the largest morphology category in the modern reporting corpus.
ordinary_explanations: small unresolved targets become approximately circular point-spread functions
nonordinary_hypotheses_not_excluded: a real population with simple round geometry
patterns.discriminating_measurement: Resolved imagery with angular size above instrument PSF and independent range.
patterns.epistemic_ceiling: Reported shape frequency is not physical-shape frequency until resolution effects are modeled.

cross_pattern_relationships.relation: High-end military sensors create unusually rich narratives but also increase classification/custody/retention barriers, so case vividness and public reproducibility can move in opposite directions.
Perceived responsiveness is hardest to validate precisely where different channels cannot be fused on a common timebase; narrative correlation can therefore overstate target-interceptor coupling.
Bright/low-detail targets tend to have poor range and shape constraints, which makes apparent speed, size, and maneuver estimates especially geometry-sensitive.
Unresolved point-like targets can become round in optical/IR imagery, so orb morphology may partly be a resolution phenotype rather than an object phenotype.

hypothesis_map.falsifier: Two independent calibrated sensor systems on a common timebase reconstruct the same target performing outside ordinary envelopes after artifact models fail.

cannot_explain_yet: every multi-channel residual without case-specific reconstruction
hypothesis_map.falsifier: Complete environmental model excludes propagation/astronomical sources while calibrated target tracks remain anomalous.

cannot_explain_yet: claims of extreme performance if those claims were later independently validated
hypothesis_map.falsifier: Calibrated trajectory exceeds plausible human platform envelope with contemporaneous airspace/test-program controls.

cannot_explain_yet: the physical nature of any individual residual
hypothesis_map.falsifier: Matched sensor-hour study shows a persistent excess in strategic contexts after equalizing instrumentation and reporting policy.

hypothesis_map.reason: The frozen corpus already contains prosaic/artifact-supported cases and unresolved cases blocked for different evidentiary reasons; no validated physical signature currently unifies them.
hypothesis_map.falsifier: A repeated calibrated signature appears across independent cases and cannot be generated by the known mixture components.

hypothesis_map.promotion_condition: At least two independent cases pass calibrated measurement, shared-object identity, environmental/artifact controls, and retain a common physically quantified signature.

initial_analysis.strongest_repeated_finding: THE_MISSING-MEASUREMENT_PATTERN_IS MORE ROBUST THAN ANY CLAIMED_OBJECT_PROPERTY
initial_analysis.current_best_explanatory_frame: HETEROGENEOUS_MIXTURE_WITH_A_SMALL_UNRESOLVED_RESIDUAL; NO SINGLE COMMON-ORIGIN MODEL IS CURRENTLY REQUIRED BY THE DATA

source_surface_notes: R1/R2 Janus frozen artifacts are canonical for fixed-six case gate states.
AARO official reporting trends are used only as modern population/control context, not retroactively as evidence about a historical case.
NARA Project Blue Book holdings establish the existence and structure of archival case/OSI collections; archive presence does not imply raw telemetry exists.
next_update_rule: Add a pattern only when at least two cases support it, unless the entry is explicitly marked NOT_RECURRING_YET as a guard against overgeneralization. Update hypothesis relationships only after source-bound case changes or new matched controls.
canonical_seal: THE FIRST COMMON PATTERN IS NOT A CRAFT SHAPE. IT IS THE GAP BETWEEN A STRONG REPORT AND A REPRODUCIBLE MEASUREMENT.
